POPULATION EFFECTS: No subgroup analyses reported, but the benefit appears consistent across the enrolled high-risk stage III melanoma population. 5. CONFOUNDERS: High discontinuation rate (52.4% vs 9.1% placebo) due to adverse events, but efficacy was maintained despite this, suggesting robust treatment effect. The trial was adequately powered and conducted over appropriate duration (median 2.7 years follow-up).
